equations_observed.external_DGROUP_offset16_plus_addend: raw OMF target displacement 2 and initial field bytes 0000; linked word = 0x000C = target public offset 0x000A + explicit addend 2.
equations_observed.far_pointer16_16: OMF LOC3 at TEXT+11 width4; linked offset word 0x0014 targets _FAR_FN at TEXT+0x14; segment word at TEXT+13 is zero before load. MZ relocation table contains image offset 13, the segment word.
equations_observed.linker_agreement: MS LINK 3.65 and RTLink Plus 6.10 emit byte-identical 28-byte load images and identical MZ relocation membership (segment 0, offset 13).
equations_observed.near_PC_relative_offset16: OMF LOC1 self-relative fixup at TEXT+8, raw field 0; linked signed word = +6 = target _NEAR_FN at 0x10 - (field address 8 + width 2).

EXTRN _global_word:WORD
EXTRN _near_fn:NEAR
EXTRN _far_fn:FAR
_TEXT SEGMENT WORD PUBLIC 'CODE'
ASSUME CS:_TEXT
PUBLIC _probe
_probe PROC NEAR
 mov ax, WORD PTR _global_word
 mov bx, WORD PTR _global_word+2
 call _near_fn
 call FAR PTR _far_fn
 ret
_probe ENDP
_TEXT ENDS
END
